title: Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Review: BMW-Branded Johor 21K at Toppen
seo_title: Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Review | BMW Johor Malaysia
meta_description: The Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 (BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon): September 20 at Toppen Shopping Centre, JB. 21K, 10K, 5K with registration open.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at Toppen Shopping Centre in Johor Bahru, this dual-branded (BMW Millennium Welt / Tebrau City) half marathon offers three distances with registration open. A premium automotive-branded Malaysian race.
verdict: The Tebrau City Half Marathon — also branded as the BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon — brings premium automotive branding to Johor Bahru. Organised by Ultron and powered by JomRun, it offers three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. Toppen Shopping Centre is one of JB's newest lifestyle malls, providing a modern race-hub venue. The BMW association suggests above-average production values and quality race merchandise. For runners wanting a brand-backed Johor half marathon with Singapore proximity, this is a strong, bookable pick.

sections.heading: BMW + Ultron at Toppen JB
paragraphs: The BMW Millennium Welt branding adds premium automotive cachet to a JomRun-powered Johor race. [1] Toppen Shopping Centre is a modern lifestyle mall in JB's Tebrau corridor. Ultron handles organisation — a known Malaysian race operator. Johor Bahru's proximity to Singapore (causeway crossing) makes this one of the most accessible Malaysian races for Singapore-based runners.
